gloss: some years ago; a few years back

definitions.gloss: some years ago; a few years back; in previous years
definitions.explanation: An indefinite past time several years before now — more remote than {去年|きょねん} (last year) but typically within recent memory. Has a slightly formal or literary tone.

examples.japanese: {先年|せんねん}⟦{亡|な}くなった→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}す→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧。
examples.english: I think of my grandfather, who passed away some years ago.

examples.japanese: {先年|せんねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{震災|しんさい}→震災：14610_shinsai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: The damage from the earthquake disaster a few years back still remains.

examples.japanese: {先年|せんねん}⟦{出版|しゅっぱん}→出版：03222_shuppan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{著書|ちょしょ}→著書：14083_chosho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{再評価|さいひょうか}→再評価：28226_saihyouka⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: His book, published a few years ago, is being reevaluated.

notes:
{先|せん} (previous, earlier) + ⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ (year). Used more in writing and formal speech than in casual conversation.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧: last year — specifically the year before this one
- {一昨年|おととし}: the year before last — exactly two years ago
- {数年前|すうねんまえ}: a few years ago — neutral, common in conversation
- {往年|おうねん}: bygone years, days of yore — more literary, evokes nostalgia

REGISTER: Sounds slightly stiff or written; in casual speech {数年前|すうねんまえ} or '⟦この{前|まえ}→この前：25259_konomae⟧' is more natural.
